{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_sales = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check comparability
print('Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n', pd.crosstab(completed_sales['channel'], completed_sales['customer_segment']))

# Compute revenue by channel and segment
revenue_by_channel_segment = completed_sales.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].sum()

print('\nRevenue by channel and segment:\n', revenue_by_channel_segment)"}
